walkthroughs.body_html:
Aspects of Hispanic Society: Modern and Traditional Values — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Aspects of Hispanic Society: Modern and Traditional Values brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Aspects of Hispanic Society: Modern and Traditional Values.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am browsing the internet'?
options: navego por internet
estoy navegando por internet
estuve navegando
he navegado
digital revolution
digital divide
digital privacy
digital banking

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am watching TV right now' emphasising the action is ongoing?
options: Veo la televisión ahora mismo.
Estoy viendo la televisión ahora mismo.
Either position with the same meaning.
Soy viendo la televisión.

mcqs.q: What goes between 'veo' and 'mi amigo' in 'I see my friend'?
options: Personal 'a' - 'Veo A mi amigo'.
Nothing.
De.
Either position with the same meaning.

mcqs.q: Where do most descriptive adjectives go relative to the noun?
options: After the noun: 'la casa BLANCA'.
Either position with the same meaning.
Before the noun, as in English.
De.
